第一卷 败落的岳家第一章 超级散魔

南岳衡山祝融峰的山顶，一块悬空凸兀的巨大石块上，一个黑色的身影在夜风中衣襟猎猎作响。

这人一袭黑袍，在巨大的石块上盘膝而坐，眼神一片深邃，仿佛让人多看上一眼也会感到心悸。刚毅的脸上此时看不出任何的表情，只是静静的坐着，好像在等待着什么。

今晚的月色很皎白，空旷的天空上还凌乱地挂着几颗闪亮的星辰。在这皎白的月色下，以至于那黑袍人的身影远远看去就像一只昂月长啸的黑狼一般。

黑袍人名叫陆风，经过近千年的修行，他已经是渡过五次天劫的超级散仙。而他已经感觉到第六次天劫就会在今晚降临，成功就飞升仙魔界，从此脱离三界不入六道轮回。要是失败的话那就魂飞魄散从此世上就再也没有陆风这个人，也无法再入六道轮回。

前面的五次天劫每次他都是九死一生，每次天劫也一次比一次厉害，第五次天劫的时候要不是靠着手中的法器，陆风早就丧身在了天雷的轰击之下。

片刻，空旷的天空中缓缓地漂浮过来几片漆黑的乌云，祝融峰顶也顿时变得昏暗起来。陆风微微的动了动身，随即只听他喃喃的道：终于要来了么？

随着乌云聚集的越来越多，整座祝融峰都已经被笼罩在了一片昏暗之中，一股无比恐怖的令人心悸的气息开始从厚厚的乌云内弥漫出来。

“来吧天劫，你阻挡不了我陆风，神挡杀神，魔挡诛魔，我陆风一路逆天而行誓登仙魔界。”陆风突然对天狂笑而道。随即双手间结起一个奇异的手印，周身顿时涌出一片浓郁的滔天真气气。

修真者，无论是修道还是修魔，都是逆天而行乃为天道所不容。所以到了最后都会受到天道的惩罚招来天劫阻挡，天劫一共有六次，一次比一次厉害，而能一路修行到渡劫期的万中只有二三，而能抵挡住一两次天劫的也只有百之二三。现在整个当今世上的散仙和散魔加起来也没有三十个，至于像陆风这样已经度过五次天劫的也只有三人，而整个当今世上成功度过六次天劫飞升进入仙魔界的万年来也只有一两个，这个比例太小了。

“滋”似乎感觉到了陆风身上的滔天气息，天空中厚厚的乌云内忽的闪过一丝刺眼的雷光，随即云层开始向内挤压，形成起一个恐怖的漫天深深黑洞，黑洞内闪电不停的滋滋做响。

“轰”黑洞内的闪电终于到了一个饱满的程度，第一束天雷携带着令人心悸的气息劈向了陆风。

陆风神情一沉，手中的手印变幻，一个青色的护身罡圈迅速把自己笼罩在了其中，双手中一片浓郁的青芒支撑着护身罡圈。

“砰”一束天雷劈在了陆风布起的护身罡圈上，随即青色的护身罡圈猛的一凹，陆风的脸色也是兀的苍白了几分。手印再变，陆风双手中的芒迅速把被天雷劈凹的护身罡圈修补了起来。

“轰”陆风刚修补好护身罡圈，第二道天雷又劈了下来，随即天空中轰隆的雷声不断，一道道天雷不停的劈向陆风的护身罡圈。整座祝融峰的周围已经被一些散雷轰的一片狼藉，而整个山顶被陆风的护身罡圈笼罩着，并没有被毁坏。

“妈的，这第一轮天雷就比第五次天劫的第三轮天雷还要强大。”一个时辰后，第一轮天劫终于被陆风抗衡过去了。第一轮天雷的最后一道闪电结束后，陆风不禁大声的骂道，此时的陆风脸色一片苍白，嘴角也有着一丝血迹，不由迅速往嘴里塞进了几颗丹药好补充真气，接下来的第二轮天雷将会更加的疯狂。

“滋滋”黑色的恐怖黑洞再次滋滋的闪烁着令人心悸的闪电，随着云层的继续增加和挤压，由漆黑云层形成的恐怖黑洞也在继续增大，里面闪烁的雷电也越来越刺眼和心悸。

“轰”第二轮的第一道天雷狂轰而下，拉开了第二轮天雷轰顶的序幕。

“五行焚魔锁”一个血红的圆盘法器被陆风抛向了空中，手中结起一个诡异的手印，血红的圆盘法器迅速在陆风的头顶变大，整整遮盖起了整座祝融峰。随即一片浓郁的血气冲天而起，弥漫着整座祝融峰。

“叭”第一道天雷落在了五行焚魔锁上，锁中血红的光芒一下暗了起来，兀的，五个巨大的恐怖鬼头从血气中冲出，大嘴一张，带着口腔内恶心的红色**向那束天雷闪电咬去。

“吱吱”五个恐怖的血红鬼头发出诡异的恐怖叫声，一束闪电片刻就被它们吞噬的干干净净。

“轰轰”两道天雷同时劈了下来，紧接着是第四道，第五道，第二轮天雷终于开始疯狂起来。

陆风的神情无比的凝重，每一道天雷的攻击，都会让他心中一颤，脸色已经是一片灰白。五行焚魔锁是他最后应付天劫的凭仗，本来他是准备用五行焚魔锁来应付最后一道天雷的，可没想到第六次天劫会这么变态，不得不第二轮就拿出了五行焚魔锁。

“吱吱”在天雷的猛烈攻击下，五行焚魔锁中的五个鬼头已经慢慢的吃不消了，血红的颜色也开始在一道道天雷的轰击下变得暗淡了起来，但还是疯狂的迎向密集的一道道天雷。

“轰”又是一个时辰后，第二轮的最后一道天雷终于过去了，在最后一道天雷下，五行焚魔锁被轰的支离破碎，五个恐怖的血红鬼头也被天雷击成了一片烟雾消失在了空中。

“哧”陆风张嘴喷出了一口鲜血，体内的真气如雷般翻涌，整个人看起来萎靡无力。

“滋滋”方圆万里的乌云都向着祝融峰汇集了过来，厚厚的乌云遮盖了天地，那个由乌云形成的恐怖黑洞也再次发生了变化。黑洞开始旋转起来，所有的闪电都流进了黑洞内的一个强劲的漆黑漩涡中。

整片天地一片漆黑，皎白的月色早就被厚厚的乌云淹埋了。只有漆黑的漩涡中闪闪雷电发出的光芒明暗交替的闪烁在祝融峰上。

陆风一股脑儿往嘴中赛进了一把丹药，随即勉强凝聚起全身翻涌的真气。最后一轮天雷要来了，虽然最后一轮天雷只有一道，但这一道天雷简直就有着毁天灭地的威力，挨不住就只有魂飞魄散，陆风丝毫不敢大意。

“滋滋”密集的闪电在漆黑的黑洞漩涡内咆哮着，兀的，整个巨大的黑洞被漆黑的漩涡撕扯了进去。紧接着，天地开始了一阵微微的晃动，一束直径足有一米长的巨大闪电从漩涡中冲出，狠狠的劈向了陆风。

“诛仙”与之同时，陆风对天一道大喝，手中一个青色的巨大恐怖光球也迅速迎向了那道巨大的闪电。

“砰砰砰砰”一连串的惊天巨响震彻天地，两股力量从上而下一起剧烈的爆破声，一串刺眼的巨大光芒就两千里外也能看见。

陆风还是低估了最后一道天雷的威力，巨大的电柱并没有受到他青色光球的阻挡，瞬间把他笼罩在内，随即整座祝融峰刹那间被最后一道天雷夷为了平地。

陆风渡劫失败了，躯体在天雷中化作了一片灰烬，埋在了无边的沙土中。一个绝世散仙损落在了祝融峰。

乌云散去，皎白的月色再次照耀在了大地，空旷的天空中还是那几颗凌乱的星辰。一切仿佛没有发生过，唯一留下的证据就是祝融峰已经成了一片平地，此次以后再也没有祝融峰了。

Volume 1: The Decline of the Yue Family Chapter 1: Super Scattered Demon

On the top of Zhurong Peak in Nanyue Hengshan Mountain, on a huge hanging rock, a black figure made a sound in the night wind.

This man was dressed in black robes, sitting cross-legged on a huge stone, with a deep look in his eyes, as if one would feel heart palpitations even if he took one more look at him.There was no expression on his resolute face at this time, he just sat quietly, as if waiting for something.

The moonlight is very bright tonight, and there are a few shining stars hanging messily in the empty sky.Under the bright white moonlight, the figure of the man in black robe looked like a black wolf roaring in the moonlight from a distance.

The man in black robe is named Lu Feng. After nearly a thousand years of practice, he has become a super immortal who has survived five heavenly tribulations.And he has already felt that the sixth heavenly tribulation will come tonight. If he succeeds, he will ascend to the world of immortals and demons, and will never enter the six realms of reincarnation.If he fails, his soul will be shattered. From now on, Lu Feng will no longer exist in the world, and he will never be able to enter the six realms of reincarnation again.

He had a narrow escape from death in each of the previous five catastrophes, and each catastrophe was more severe than the last. If it were not for the magical weapon in his hand during the fifth catastrophe, Lu Feng would have been killed by the thunder.

After a moment, a few dark clouds slowly floated over in the empty sky, and the top of Zhurong Peak suddenly became dim.Lu Feng moved slightly, and then he murmured: Is it finally coming?

As more and more dark clouds gathered, the entire Zhurong Peak was shrouded in darkness, and an extremely terrifying and heart-stopping aura began to permeate from the thick dark clouds.

"Come on, Heavenly Tribulation, you can't stop me, Lu Feng. Gods can stop the gods and kill gods, and demons can stop the demons. I, Lu Feng, go against the will of heaven and swear to ascend to the world of immortals and demons." Lu Feng suddenly laughed wildly at the sky.Immediately, a strange hand seal was formed between his hands, and a rich and surging pure Qi suddenly surged out of his body.

Those who cultivate the truth, whether they are cultivating Taoism or cultivating demons, are acting against heaven and are not tolerated by heaven.Therefore, in the end, they will be punished by heaven and blocked by heavenly tribulations. There are six heavenly tribulations in total, each time more severe than the last. Only two or three out of ten thousand people can practice all the way to the tribulation stage, and only 23 out of 100 can withstand one or two heavenly tribulations.There are only thirty loose immortals and loose demons in the entire world today. As for Lu Feng, there are only three people who have survived five heavenly tribulations. In the entire world, there are only one or two who have successfully survived six heavenly tribulations and ascended into the world of immortals and demons in the past ten thousand years. This ratio is too small.

"Zi" seemed to feel Lu Feng's monstrous aura. A dazzling lightning suddenly flashed through the thick dark clouds in the sky. Then the clouds began to squeeze inward, forming a terrifying deep black hole that filled the sky. Lightning kept crackling in the black hole.

"Boom" The lightning in the black hole finally reached a full level, and the first beam of thunder struck Lu Feng with a heart-stopping aura.

Lu Feng's expression sank, and the handprints in his hands changed. A cyan protective ring quickly enveloped him, and a thick green light in his hands supported the protective ring.

"Bang" a beam of thunder struck the protective ring set up by Lu Feng, and then the green protective ring suddenly dented, and Lu Feng's face turned a bit pale.The handprint changed again, and the light in Lu Feng's hands quickly repaired the protective ring that was dented by the thunder.

"Boom" Lu Feng had just repaired the protective ring when a second thunder struck down. Then the thunder continued to rumble in the sky, and the thunder continued to strike at Lu Feng's protective ring.The entire Zhurong Peak has been in a mess by some scattered thunder, but the entire top of the mountain is shrouded by Lu Feng's protective ring and has not been destroyed.

"Damn, this first round of thunder is more powerful than the third round of thunder in the fifth heavenly tribulation." An hour later, the first round of heavenly thunder was finally countered by Lu Feng.After the last lightning strike of the first round of thunder ended, Lu Feng couldn't help but curse loudly. At this time, Lu Feng's face was pale, and there was a trace of blood on the corner of his mouth. He couldn't help but quickly stuffed a few pills into his mouth to replenish his energy. The next round of thunder would be even more crazy.

"Zizi" The terrifying black hole once again flashed with heart-stopping lightning. As the clouds continued to increase and squeeze, the terrifying black hole formed by the dark clouds continued to grow, and the flashing thunder and lightning inside became more and more dazzling and heart-stopping.

"Boom" The first thunder of the second round crashed down, kicking off the second round of thunder.

"Five Elements Burning Demon Lock" A blood-red disc magic weapon was thrown into the air by Lu Feng, with a strange handprint in his hand. The blood-red disc magic weapon quickly grew in size above Lu Feng's head, covering the entire Zhurong Peak.Immediately, a rich blood energy rose into the sky and filled the entire Zhurong Peak.

"Bah!" The first sky thunder fell on the Five Elements Burning Demon Lock, and the blood-red light in the lock suddenly dimmed. Suddenly, five huge terrifying ghost heads rushed out of the blood, opened their mouths, and bit the bunch of sky thunder and lightning with disgusting red flesh in their mouths.

"Squeak!" Five terrifying blood-red ghost heads made a weird and terrifying cry, and a beam of lightning was completely swallowed up by them in a moment.

"Boom!" Two thunderbolts struck down at the same time, followed by the fourth and fifth thunderbolts. The second round of thunderbolts finally started to go crazy.

Lu Feng's expression was extremely solemn. Every attack from the sky thunder would make his heart tremble, and his face was already gray.The Five Elements Burning Demon Lock was his last resort in dealing with the Heavenly Tribulation. Originally, he was planning to use the Five Elements Burning Demon Lock to deal with the last thunderbolt, but he did not expect that the sixth Heavenly Tribulation would be so abnormal, and he had to use the Five Elements Burning Demon Lock in the second round.

"Zhizhi" Under the fierce attack of the sky thunder, the five ghost heads in the Five Elements Burning Demon Lock have slowly been unable to bear it. The blood-red color has also begun to dim under the bombardment of the sky thunder, but they are still facing the dense sky thunder crazily.

"Boom" Another hour later, the last thunder of the second round finally passed. Under the last thunder, the Five Elements Burning Demon Lock was shattered to pieces, and the five terrifying blood-red ghost heads were also struck by the thunder into a sheet of smoke and disappeared into the air.

"Chi!" Lu Feng opened his mouth and spit out a mouthful of blood. The true energy in his body surged like thunder, and his whole body looked weak and weak.

"Zizi" The dark clouds covering thousands of miles around gathered towards Zhurong Peak. Thick dark clouds covered the sky and the earth, and the terrifying black hole formed by the dark clouds also changed again.The black hole began to spin, and all the lightning flowed into a powerful dark vortex inside the black hole.

The whole sky and earth were dark, and the bright moonlight had long been buried by thick dark clouds.Only the light from the flashing thunder and lightning in the dark vortex flickered alternately between light and dark on Zhurong Peak.

Lu Feng stuffed a handful of elixirs into his mouth, and then managed to gather the energy surging throughout his body.The last round of thunder is coming. Although there is only one thunder in the last round, this thunder has the power to destroy the heaven and the earth. If it can't be withstood, the soul will be scattered. Lu Feng does not dare to be careless at all.

"Zizi" dense lightning roared in the dark whirlpool of the black hole, and suddenly, the entire huge black hole was torn into the dark whirlpool.Immediately afterwards, the world began to shake slightly, and a huge beam of lightning with a diameter of one meter rushed out of the vortex and struck Lu Feng fiercely.

"Zhu Xian" At the same time, Lu Feng shouted to the sky, and a huge cyan terrifying light ball in his hand quickly faced the huge lightning.

"Bang, bang, bang, bang" a series of earth-shattering sounds shook the world, two forces exploded violently from top to bottom, and a string of dazzling huge lights could be seen two thousand miles away.

Lu Feng still underestimated the power of the last sky thunder. The huge electric pillar was not blocked by his cyan ball of light and instantly enveloped him. Then the entire Zhurong Peak was instantly leveled to the ground by the last sky thunder.

Lu Feng failed to cross the tribulation, and his body was turned into ashes by the thunder, and was buried in the boundless sand.A peerless loose immortal fell upon Zhurong Peak.

The dark clouds dispersed, and the bright white moonlight shone on the earth again, and there were still a few messy stars in the empty sky.Everything seemed to have never happened. The only evidence left was that Zhu Rongfeng had become flat ground, and there would be no more Zhurongfeng after this time.
